name: Arabesque

load.note: Lighter makes the standing leg and trunk work harder.

summary: Elephant on one leg. Hands on the footbar, one foot flat on the carriage, the other leg lifted long behind while the standing leg slides the carriage out and back.
steps: Stand on the carriage with hands on the footbar, shoulders over the bar.
Place one foot flat in front of the shoulder rest; lift the other leg behind, slightly turned out.
Breathe in to press the carriage back with the standing leg.
Breathe out to draw it home with control.

layers.title: Foot in front of the shoulder rest
Heel lifted against the shoulder rest
Foot on top of the shoulder rest

cautions.note: Weight is through the hands — try fists or forearms on the bar, or swap.
Single-leg balance on a moving carriage.

cues:
Upper body is a statue; the leg does the travelling.
Hips and shoulders square to the footbar.
Soft elbows and a soft standing knee.
Keep the back leg lifting the whole time.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Go back to Elephant on two feet
Take spring off only once the movement is steady
